scope: Latest upstream result census and exact reuse/operator API feasibility; no source mutation, builds or rerun of existing tests/science.

active_alternative.library_delta: Only rodas5p-core/src/operator.rs changed among production library sources in this compare: ShiftedOperator explicit M-hgammaJ construction now returns typed error instead of expect panic.
active_alternative.HE29_relevance: Protected HE29 JVP-only linearization has no explicit matrix; this particular explicit() error path is not reached there. No observed need to change HE29 execution pin.

no_HE29_return.scope: PR71,73,74,75 and latest midcheck branch trees contain no HE29/BASS_HE-named paths; inspected native result manifests identify generic VigilODE cases. Full branch/PR/Actions inventory is in vigilode_census.json.

findings.observation: LinearSolverConfig.preconditioner is only None/Jacobi/Direct. The strict matrix-free step rejects both assembled preconditioners. make_pc is private. OdeProblem JVP is wrapped internally as ClosureOperator; it supplies no custom preconditioner or LinearOperator factory.
findings.impact: A Schur custom preconditioner cannot be passed to the existing HE29 adaptive entry point through these public arguments.
findings.minimum_action: Preserve upstream integrator and use an opt-in Rust exact-state JVP implementation/cached payload behind supplied JvpFn. A separate low-level core Preconditioner implementation is possible in principle but would require a different driver connection; not the current minimal implementation.

findings.head: 3c0157910076ce552283c831c2be000c66671fab
findings.observation: Exact cache records all finite Jacobian entry bits and rounded inverse shift bits. Any changed bit/shape/invalid factorization invalidates the key. J and f continue to be evaluated at fresh states. FixedWidth2 falls back to Slices outside lower=upper=2. Cache is private pub(super), attached to BandState.
findings.impact: HE29 arrowhead couples gas and many photon bins and is not bandwidth-2. No public exact-cache object for a custom Schur factorization exists.
findings.minimum_action: Reuse exact-key/invalidation principle and fresh-J requirement for a model-side cache; do not label reused matrix values at merely nearby states as exact.

findings.head: 15c43ce76734d0a560fcec5909ac49f1e6f2d347
findings.observation: Requires autonomous identity-mass problem and supplied JVP; returns one raw-U coupled operational candidate. It has no adaptive integration loop. Config defaults atol1e-10/rtol1e-6. Candidate presence indicates the full-space residual gate passed, while embedded_test_passes remains a separate flag.
findings.impact: Cannot replace the existing HE29 nonautonomous segment integration call unchanged. Existing a21 OdeProblem::time_augmented_clone is a concrete augmentation API but does not supply the missing coupled adaptive driver or physical acceptance.
findings.minimum_action: Keep the current four SciPy reference pairs and sequential optional bridge. Retain coupled module as a separately identified future experimental lane only if its new driver/clock/error acceptance becomes necessary.

findings.head: 6c945b6c6e0e024d8f733c21da8d35fbcc3c5f2a
findings.observation: At each projected iterate, evaluate all 8 residual RHS tasks first; if projected residual already passes, omit 8*basis_dimension stage JVPs. Otherwise compute stage derivatives at the saved states. Basis JVP and full-space checks remain. Avoided JVP counter is counterfactual work, distinct from actual attempted/completed counts. Callback ordering and dispatch count change.
findings.impact: Useful exact-output work avoidance in that coupled correction algorithm; cannot be transplanted as a residual-first switch into the a21 sequential driver.
findings.minimum_action: Reuse accounting distinction and avoid unnecessary recomputation where exact state identity is established; do not infer a speed gain for HE29 from generic coupled benchmark ratios.

findings.object: Existing HE29 bridge CallbackState and RUN_LOCK
findings.observation: Foreign Python callbacks and single NativeOwner stdio were deliberately restricted to sequential use. PR74/75 ParallelExecution invokes up to 8 same-iterate tasks through a bounded pool.
findings.impact: Existing callback pointer Send+Sync storage is not permission to run the physical callbacks concurrently.
findings.minimum_action: Keep sequential callback execution; move repeated arithmetic behind Rust JVP with a sequential preparation callback before considering task parallelism.

published_results.head: 6c945b6c6e0e024d8f733c21da8d35fbcc3c5f2a
published_results.actual_work: Representative few-mode n12288 eps1 h0.001: eager59 JVP, lazy35,24 omitted; diffusion n96 h0.001:348→188,160 omitted.
published_results.ratios: Same-output eager1/lazy1 paired ratios for successful raw-U cases 1.2073–1.4682; lazy4 can be slower for small n96. Broad-case 1.8108 is failed-attempt cost, not solver speed. cap64 forces fallback and causes pronounced extra total work in chain/diffusion cases.
published_results.reuse_decision: Take the exact work-avoidance pattern and complete failed-work accounting; no automatic routing threshold or HE29 speed projection.

recommended_current_implementation.baseline: Keep VigilODE a21, existing sequential matrix-free adaptive integrator, normalized u endpoints [0,1], original outer and linear tolerances, original HE29 scientific admission.
recommended_current_implementation.opt_in_change: Profile confirmed JVP boundary costs, then add an exact-state native JVP arithmetic cache behind supplied JvpFn, with one preparation callback for changed u/state and exact finite payload checks.
recommended_current_implementation.cache_identity: Per-solve/per-segment ownership, u.to_bits, full z element bits and immutable callback/model identity; invalidate before failed refresh; no approximate Jacobian reuse. Preserve signed-zero conservatism.
recommended_current_implementation.boundary_validation: Only new payload and callback/cache invariants plus tiny analytic or saved real-state comparisons; inherited suites and completed HE28/HE29 source-only results are reused.
